title: Google releases security updates for Chrome
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-358.09.09.20: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – Google Releases Security Updates for Chrome
leadParagraph: Google has released Chrome version 85.0.4183.102 for Windows, Mac, and Linux.
contentHtml:
Google has released Chrome version 85.0.4183.102 for Windows, Mac, and Linux.

This version addresses vulnerabilities that an attacker could exploit to take control of an affected system.

For further information and support, please visit the following link:
https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2020/09/stable-channel-update-for-desktop.html

If you have any queries or comments with regards to this advisory, please feel free to contact TTCSIRT via contacts@ttcsirt.gov.tt
